scope: Database write barriers and administrative cascade protection for unexposed self-deletion foundation, not complete deletion acceptance.
implemented: Additive migration 097 rejects new private/security state, membership/role grants, owner transfers, messages/reactions and application ownership involving a deleted account. Explicit triggers do not depend on foreign-key enforcement.
New friendships and key-envelope deliveries involving deleted participants are rejected; preexisting recipient ciphertext/envelopes remain unchanged for surviving users.

A deleted author row cannot be DELETE-cascaded. Administrative hard deletion rejects retained identities before executing cleanup statements, with the database trigger as a second gate. Existing ordinary administrative deletion remains available for non-tombstone accounts.
No production route or UI for self deletion is exposed yet. No migration in this turn deletes an existing account or filesystem asset.
